g.text: Transfer of the pretrained pocket encoder into VoxBind
A zero-initialized spatial adapter adds experimental-ED context while the pocket tower and VoxBind remain frozen
No ligand coordinates or ligand ED
Frozen: both coordinate encoders · pocket ChannelViT · 3D U-Net · output head
At initialization, Δx=0: the integrated model exactly reproduces the frozen VoxBind baseline.
